text.tspan: Use: HPC, big data jobs that
+ can span AZs; one failure hits
+ up to 7 partitions per AZ, many
• "lowest latency / highest network throughput between instances" → Cluster
• "maximise availability, small number of critical instances" → Spread
• "big distributed, partition-aware system (Hadoop, Cassandra, Kafka)" → Partition
• "high-precision time, PTP clock (distributed DBs, financial timestamps)" → Precision time (new 4th type)
